actions.calculation_basis: Grams of Special Mix per 30g of Koleston Perfect cream

actions.prerequisite: Evenly pre-lightened hair (1/2 level lighter than target) or natural hair 9/0+
actions.developer: Welloxon Perfect Pastel 1.9% or Color Touch Emulsion 1.9%

rules.source_section: Blondor Technical Folder - User Guide (1:1.5 up to 2)

actions.warning: When applying lightener on scalp, maximum developer strength is 6% (20 Vol). Never use heat.

actions.reason: WellaPlex is NOT recommended to be mixed with Blondor Base Breakers due to specific formulation and shading.
Magma by Blondor must NEVER be applied directly to the scalp. Use in foil or freehand techniques only.

rules.source_section: Blondor Technical Folder Page 21 Services Table

actions.reason: Freelights is a closed system: ACTIFUSE network requires Freelights Powder + Freelights Developer.

actions.protocol: Skin Allergy Test 48 hours prior to service: 5g color + 5g developer on 1cm2 below crook of elbow for 45 min.
actions.warning: If client shows any signs of redness, burning, itching, or has ever experienced an allergic reaction to hair colorants, do not color.

rules.source_section: Koleston Perfect Usage Booklet Page 4 / Leaflet Page 25

lighteners.technology: Bond Builder Technology included, up to 97% less breakage
lighteners.post_treatment_requirement: Always complete BlondorPlex service with WellaPlex No. 2 for 10 minutes

lighteners.technology: White granules for true underlying pigment visibility, coconut fragrance
Rich creamy texture, high lipid concentration, chamomile for soothing
ACTIFUSE network: flexible and adhesive clay network with reduced swelling
Auto-Control System (slows lightening after 15 min with heat, 45 min without), ammonia-free cream
lighteners.default_mixing_ratio: 1 sachet powder (30g) + 1 tube cream (30g) + 30-60g Welloxon Perfect (1:1:1 to 1:1:2)

lighteners.technology: Dual lightening and matte toning in one step
lighteners.intermixable_ratio: 1:2 with other Blondor lighteners (not with Magma)

lighteners.technology: Silk Blend consistency, express 10-minute base breaking and gentle toning
